detection_bound: At next original guard boundary, no later than 2s after last successful probe if guard calls continue; blocked native/OS calls add their duration; existing hard process watchdog remains
owner_GPU_UUID_held_FD_binding_probe: Existing real PerGpuLease.check(force=True), one composite call per probe; no extra direct authority call
directory_reconciliation: Exact fresh scan once per probe and at explicit final boundary, not per step
hot_native_guard: PID/token/latch/staleness plus mandatory bound cheap RSS/Torch high-water health; native runtime/session/queue/target/callback checks remain AINav responsibility
controlled_IO: Precharge actual logical file growth before write; account temp replacement, seek rewrites, truncation, UTF8 and compressed chunks; no cross-process counter sharing
unknown_output: Unknown/missing/resized/replaced file, alias/hardlink/symlink, observation loss or read error latches stop; never silently resync
out_of_band_write_risk: Unknown writers may consume space before next probe; no absolute cap or true external high-water claim against arbitrary root writers. Disk-free fallback, ENOSPC errors and stop/new-dispatch refusal remain required
highwater_definition: Controlled regular-file logical-byte high-water, not filesystem allocated bytes/provider quota/complete external-writer peak
finalization: Irreversible shared native seal before bounded final buffer/report drain can use reserve; no native execution resumed
required_before_native_qualification: Bind all real recorder/raw/metadata writes, controller stdout/stderr and encoder output to controlled counters or separately bounded pre-reserved accounting
